Learn the Even Moss Stitch An easy crochet stitch with a simple 2-row repeat that works up quickly and creates a beautiful textured fabric. This beginner friendly crochet stitch uses just slip stitches and half double crochet (US) / half treble crochet (UK), making it easy to learn and remember. Perfect for blankets, scarves, dishcloths and lots of other crochet projects. Follow along with my step-by-step Even Moss Stitch crochet tutorial, with both US and UK crochet terms included. #crochettutorial #crochetstitch #evenmossstitch #crochetforbeginners #purlnhook
